prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1359; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came from the other direction. My car spun partway around before stopping. I was shaken, but I got out and waited for the police to arrive. I have given the same account of what happened every time I have described it, to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to my own family. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this claim for the damage to my vehicle and for a wrist fracture I received in the collision, which has since been treated and is still limiting my use of my right hand.
